body.name: \(\mathscr E(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\)
body.construction: The smallest class containing rational constants and coordinates of \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), closed under finite sums, differences, products, and division by an expression whose strict positivity on \(\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{ocsi}}(G,\mathcal C)\) is recorded in the derivation syntax.
